approval: Locked to the file Kendon printed, plus the forefoot stitch Kendon approved on 2026-11-13. At 11:27 AM MT he kept wall_loops at 2 so the heel and arch keep two walls. At 4:35 PM MT the extra hour of print time was the travels between gap beads that already meet. gap_infill_speed was already 26 mm/s, the same as the outer wall. filter_out_gap_fill 8 drops gap polylines shorter than 8 mm; the forefoot stitch is longer than that. The belt-edge center seam stays aligned. On 2026-11-18 Kendon turned detect_thin_wall back off (it had been set to 1 by #29, 3717053d3c). Classic walls, gap fill everywhere, the 8 mm filter, 25% min bead width, and wall_loops 2 stay. reduce_crossing_wall stays 1. The same day he asked for no hollow pocket between a top skin and a bottom skin. The thin toe is two 1.0 mm walls and a gap bead that does not reach either wall. Widening the walls to 1.3 mm closed the toe and opened 13 wall-crossing travels, and the 15-30% band stayed open, so the walls stay 1. A postprocessor that widened that gap bead over-extruded (beads to 2.98 mm and out-and-back retraces), so it is not used. ApexCore sets ensure_vertical_shell_thickness to ensure_all and top_shell_layers to 1. top_shell_thickness stays 0 so the shell is exactly one layer, not the 0.6 mm floor. Line width stays 1. No other changes without Kendon's approval.

forefoot_stitch.seam: stays aligned at the belt-edge center (g2b_anchor unchanged)

wall_loops.why: Two loops stay on the whole path. Classic walls omit the inner loop only where the section cannot hold two closed loops, which is the thin forefoot on a youth insole and on an M13. No fixed belt-length cutoff.

filter_out_gap_fill.why: A threshold of 0 keeps every gap polyline. After beads that already meet are printed as one path, the polylines shorter than 8 mm are scattered heel and arch islands, and the travel between those islands is the time still above the pre-stitch print. The forefoot stitch polylines are longer than 8 mm.

detect_thin_wall.why: Kendon 2026-11-18. #29 (3717053d3c) turned this on from the pre-stitch 0. Short outer-wall pieces on the midfoot edges and the heel rim were each treated as a seam. Turned back off. The other stitch keys stay.

ensure_vertical_shell_thickness.why: Kendon 2026-11-18. ensure_all merges a sparse gap narrower than about 1.2 solid-line spacings into internal solid infill. The sample toe gaps are 0.67 mm and 1.06 mm. Solid lines stay at the locked 1.0 mm width. The heel range already used ensure_all.

top_shell_layers.why: Kendon 2026-11-18. top_shell_layers 0 turns the uncovered dorsal skin into sparse gyroid, so a thin toe has a bottom skin and no top skin between them. One solid top layer bonds that skin. The Orca default of 4 is not used.

top_shell_thickness.why: Left at 0. A 0.6 mm floor would add more than one layer at 0.46 mm and paint solid skin across the thick body.

gap_infill_speed.why: Already equal to outer_wall_speed in the shared G2b block. Not the extra hour. Locked so a slower default cannot replace it.
